scope: One software repository and its local verification surfaces

gates.required_evidence: Focused checks selected by the changed failure class and bound to the exact revision

secrets.delivery: provider-managed injection directly to the intended process
secrets.artifact_scan: project non-revealing secret scan before durable publication
secrets.forensic_quarantine: restricted store outside model context with explicit retention and audit
secrets.clean_context: new transcript and process state after leak-path canary evidence
secrets.encrypted_envelopes: forbidden unless separately accepted by the repository owner

program.trigger: persistent dependent migration, multiple repositories, or shared external state
program.repair_authority: repository owner through an authority source independent of the invalidated control

policy.reporting: task outcome with exact test and revision evidence
